mapper.insert: INSERT INTO oauth_users (provider, provider_user_id, email, display_name, avatar_url, role) VALUES (#{provider}, #{providerUserId}, #{email}, #{displayName}, #{avatarUrl}, #{role}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE email = VALUES(email), display_name = VALUES(display_name), avatar_url = VALUES(avatar_url), role = VALUES(role), last_login_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT created_at FROM oauth_users WHERE LOWER(email) = LOWER(#{email}) LIMIT 1
SELECT uid FROM oauth_users WHERE LOWER(email) = LOWER(#{email}) LIMIT 1
